_source: Software Factory at f36c65e with lane BD's round-21 and round-22 patches (factory/src/workflow_score.rs; a unit's direction in QL's law's spelling, DLW build ruling 2026-11-05), the env-2 seat's debug build of 5 Nov 2026; its own CLI walked headless on a scratch project (factory project setup, factory workflow commission --root, factory workflow score, factory workflow edit), the song a copy of Factory's development-and-knowledge workflow fixture commissioned from the project root; the scratch path is written /walk. Each refusal is the factory.workflow-diagnostic/v1 document Factory's CLI wrote on stderr (exit 2). First captured 3 Nov 2026 from dlw/843-score, when Factory wrote a direction `forward` or `returning`; recaptured 5 Nov with the same edits in the same order, the heads edit giving eros-verify CS3 and forward-synthesis. vak_block: QL's Vāk-block instrument verbatim (`ql context-frame team-space --json`, its instrument vak-block; the installed QL a2aa0a7 and the env-2 seat's QL build at 7bb2535 with round 22 answer byte-identically). unit_steps: `ql vak unit-steps <unit> --json` on eros-verify's heads, that seat build; unit_steps_refused: its stderr for the frame CF8 (exit 2).

units.concern: Scope the change and write the plan it will be built from
units.escalate: Escalate scope that crosses another repository's ownership
may: read the repository and its governing documents
units.requiredDifference: A bounded plan: files, behaviour, tests and the checks the repository already runs
units.returns: Return the plan with its scope boundary and the exact verification it will need
units.stop: Stop when the request needs an owner decision before it can be scoped
success: the plan cites the repository's own gates

units.concern: Implement the plan test-first in the repository
units.escalate: Escalate any change to protected or authored ground
may: write source and tests on a feature branch
run the repository's local checks
units.requiredDifference: The planned behaviour exists with tests that fail without it
units.returns: Return the branch, the changed files and the test evidence
units.stop: Stop when the plan cannot be implemented without widening scope
success: run the tests named in the plan and quote their results

units.concern: Verify the implementation against the plan with the repository's real gates
units.escalate: Escalate a gate that cannot be run in the available environment
may: run tests, format and lint checks
read the branch
units.requiredDifference: Executed evidence says whether the change does what the plan required
units.returns: Return the commands run, their results and every failure found
units.stop: Stop when the branch cannot be built
success: quote executed results; never infer a pass from a name or a fixture

units.concern: Find the organising cause of any verification failure and repair it at its owner
units.escalate: Escalate a defect whose repair belongs to another owner
may: write repairs and regression tests on the feature branch
units.requiredDifference: Each failure has a located cause and a repair proven at the level it failed
units.returns: Return the causes, the repairs and the re-run evidence, or state that verification found no defect
units.stop: Stop at once when verification returned no failure; return that finding with its evidence
success: never weaken an assertion to turn a failure green

units.concern: Finish the branch: final checks, commit and a pull request ready for review
units.escalate: Escalate a protected-branch or permission refusal
may: commit on the feature branch
open a pull request; never merge
units.requiredDifference: A reviewable pull request with its checks and an honest description
units.returns: Return the pull request ref, the final check results and any open item with its reason
units.stop: Stop before merging; merge is the owner's review decision
success: the final check results are from the pushed head

units.concern: Return what the development taught through the NOW field and the wiki return door
units.escalate: Never edit wiki.json directly; escalate promotion decisions to the wiki owner
may: write one attributed Return to the project NOW field
propose a wiki promotion through NOW
units.requiredDifference: Durable learning leaves the session as an attributed Return pointing at its evidence
units.returns: Return the NOW Return ref and any wiki promotion it proposes, each with its lineage
units.stop: Stop when nothing durable was learned; a routine record is enough
success: the Return points at the pull request and its evidence, not a paraphrase

allocate.performs: The Run performs the edition it was commissioned with; the song's next Run performs this one.

labels.description: dialogue with the person; the person completes the remaining layers
an admitted undertaking; it names its authority
Ground: prospective What do we have? retrospective What don't we know?
Definition: prospective What must be true? retrospective What evidence exists?
Operation: prospective What is being done? retrospective What blocks us?
Pattern: prospective What shape does it take? retrospective What repeats?
Context: prospective Where and when in the larger frame? retrospective What sources inform?
Integration: prospective What was produced? retrospective What crystallises?
the governed cycle compose → perform → record → rehear → recompose; it needs an authorised undertaking
Prospective: the pass forward through the pairs
Retrospective: the pass back through the pairs

unit_steps.standing: QL's breakdown of one unit's heads: each head's meaning as the Vāk-block instrument holds it, and the composition steps the heads fix. The steps run in a `ql.vak-composition/v1` composition once it has bound the unit's whole and entered its context, and names the context, oikonomia and basis each step takes: a unit names its whole, it does not carry it. It stores nothing, composes nothing and grants nothing.
